Leading HVAC distributor looking for an Internal Sales Executive to join their Fareham branch.

You'll ideally have experience in a trade, merchant, distribution or wholesale environment, whether that's in internal sales, customer service, trade counter or branch administration. HVAC experience isn't essential.

Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm

Package:
- 30,000 salary
- 25 days holiday
- Company pension
- Genuine opportunities for career progression

If you enjoy working with customers, keeping things organised and being part of a busy branch, I'd be happy to tell you more.

description:
FRENCH SPEAKING CUSTOMER SERVICE EXECUTIVE - GOLF SECTOR

Do you speak fluent French and have a good knowledge of golf?

We are hiring for a French speaking Customer Service Executive to join a highly successful global brand in the golf sector. You will be working on the French speaking business markets of Europe, supporting the Sales Manager and B2 B customers with customer related queries and orders.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Excellent salary available (further details available upon request) + superb benefits (up to 15% bonus, private medical cover, pension, generous staff discounts plus many more!)

LOCATION

Hybrid role, 3 days a week in the office which are based close to Reading

LANGUAGES

Fluent French and English is essential.

COMPANY

Our client is a globally recognised leader in the golf industry, renowned for designing and manufacturing premium golf equipment, clothing and accessories.

THE ROLE

As part of their global sales and customer support team, your role as a French speaking Customer Service Executive will be to manage inbound and outbound sales activity, ensuring queries are handled efficiently. Working as part of a collaborative and high-performing team, you'll build strong relationships internally and externally with clients and partners to support both service and sales success.

Your role will typically include the following duties and responsibilities:
- Provide day-to-day sales and service support to Area Sales Managers and customers in France
- Handle inbound calls and emails, identifying and resolving customer queries efficiently
- Support outbound sales and service activity alongside the field sales team
- Identify opportunities to upsell during customer interactions
- Accurately record and manage customer interactions within CRM systems
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships, ensuring a high level of satisfaction
- Develop knowledge of order processing, shipping and wider business operations

CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE / SKILLS
- Fluent French and English is essential
- A strong customer focus with a passion for delivering excellent service
- Previous experience in a customer service and/or sales role
- Strong communication skills with confidence on the phone and via email
- Ability to build relationships and work effectively with internal stakeholders
- A knowledge of golf is essential

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Excellent salary available + superb benefits (private medical cover, pension, generous staff discounts, EV Salary Sacrifice + many more!

To be considered for this excellent opportunity, please click the Apply Now button and send your CV to us.
